headline: Giants OLB Brian Burns Tore Meniscus In Addition To ACL
summary: Testing from earlier this week confirmed Brian Burns tore his ACL in Week 3. The Giants edge rusher will undergo surgery today before beginning a lengthy recovery process. That is not the only damage being repaired in Burns’ case, though. His right knee also suffered a lateral meniscus tear, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports. Today’s procedure […]

headline: Why Steelers traded Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys, what's next?
summary: Our insiders dive into Porter's fit in Dallas, his potential for a contract extension and what's next for the Steelers.

headline: Report: Joey Porter Jr. trade has a term that protects against an ongoing hold-in
summary: In trading for former Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr., the Cowboys are taking a leap of faith that Porter will play without a new contract.

headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels says he's taking injury day by day
summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels said Thursday he has no concerns about reinjuring his left elbow and is "taking it day by day" on the possibility of starting against the Colts on Sunday in London.

headline: John Lynch on Nick Bosa's return: Calf injuries are sometimes murky
summary: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa remains out with the calf injury that kept him from playing in Week 3 and a return date has remained unclear as the team prepares to face the Broncos this weekend.

headline: Are we seeing more NFL quarterback injuries than normal this season?
summary: There have been eight QB injuries through three weeks of the NFL season, up a little bit from recent years. Is it a trend or just an outlier -- and is there a clear reason?
